title: Unit Review: Law and Legal Language
goal: Review the voice of a rule, the old future subjunctive, who a rule applies to, conditions and the impersonal style of the law.
grammar: Unit Review: Law and Legal Language

items: I can read the future as the voice of a rule and recognise the old future subjunctive.
I can say who a rule applies to and under what conditions.
I can write a prohibition and a penalty in impersonal legal style.
